notes.title: Update Available!!!
notes.content:
Updates Available!!!

The bugs fixes & functionalities added are:

Hovering over inventory items now show the name of it.
Dialogues for wrong use of item.
Inventory slots get organised by themselves.
Hint button is now more flexible. It navigates towards the next available action.
Changed 2 hops to make it more difficult and enjoyable.
Inventory scrolling improved.
Improved quality of the images in the inventory.
Other small bug fixes.

We highly appreciate you patience and support.
Please get back to us for any suggestions.

Thanks
Dev Team...

notes.title: New Update Available!!!
notes.content:
Hi Gamers,

We have resolved some of the issues in the game to make gameplay more better and enjoyable.

[b]The bugs we have fixed are:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Menu options bug fixed.
[*] Hog objects have now better collision and easy to collect.
[*] Resolution error fixed
[/list]

[b]Improvements in the game:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now click anywhere when dialogue appears to see next dialogue or even perform an action e.g. using item.
[*] Cursor changes while picking up item
[*] Sound assigned for hog object pickup
[*] Popup added for picked up items which shows information about them; e.g. name.
[*] Shine hints are bigger than before.
[*] Removed Sarah room door after using an object.
[*] Examine areas are inaccessible once done.
[*] Penalty for spam clicking in the hog
[*] Assigned sound for using an item.
[*] Tutorial update
[/list]
[h1][b]Upcoming Updates[/b][/h1]
We are working more on this game for better experience.
what can you expect from future updates?
[list]
[*] Adding a map to show next available action in a particular location.
[*] Hovering over inventory items will show the name of it.
[*] Dialogues for wrong use of item.
[*] Inventory slots will get organised by themselves.
[*] Hint button will be more flexible.
[/list]
We appreciate you patience and support.
Please get back to us for any suggestions.

Thanks
Dev Team...

notes.title: Upcoming: Game will be available in 14 languages.
notes.content:
[b]Hello Gamers,[/b]
[b][h2]Thanks for all your support & love [/h2][/b]
We have decided to localize this game in 13 different languages.
The languages we are including are:
[list]
[*] Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] German
[*] Korean
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Dutch
[*] Turkish
[*] Swedish
[*] Danish
[/list]
Stay connected for the dates.
Thanks...
